target_name: EBITDA Yield with Organic Knowledge Share
rationale: A defensible anchor swap that trades a book-based for a flow-based cheapness measure at higher coverage, though it is incremental relative to the existing oancf-anchored gen-1 signal, and the hypothesis is loosely worded (EBITDA is itself reduced by expensed R&D, which arguably strengthens rather than bypasses the mechanism).

target_name: Dual-Anchor Cheapness with Unrecorded Capital Share
rationale: Averaging hard-book B/M with sales-to-price is a reasonable consolidation and correctly diagnoses that the gen-0 failure came from multiplicative shrinkage, but both anchors share the same market-cap denominator so the claimed noise diversification is limited and the incremental content over the existing winner is modest.

target_name: Cheap Builders Versus Cheap Buyers of Intangible Capital
rationale: The organic-minus-acquired rank difference makes an economically real distinction that is only implicit in the incumbent conditioner, is internally consistent with the expected positive sign, and is constructed to avoid the 0/0 degeneracy of a direct share ratio.

TS_COUNT(xrd,5) is largely a Compustat reporting-convention indicator that collapses to a near-binary "is an R&D firm" dummy, so it both conflates disclosure with economics and overlaps heavily with the incumbent conditioner (which is already ~0 for non-reporters), leaving little independent variation among genuine innovators.

target_name: Within-Industry Hard-Book Value and Knowledge Share
rationale: Industry-demeaning both legs of the existing winning signal is a standard robustness transformation rather than a new mechanism, and while the sector-tilt-versus-firm-mispricing diagnostic is genuinely informative, it is a cosmetic variant of the archived gen-0 composite rather than a substantive refinement.

target_name: Cheap Firms Shifting from Acquired to Organic Intangibles
rationale: This is essentially the gen-1 "Innovation Outsourcing at Rich Prices" signal with the sign flipped and the three components reweighted — the same economic content (organic-versus-purchased intangible growth interacted with valuation) — so it risks being a rediscovery, even though the reweighting is motivated by a plausible CMA-loading diagnosis.
